factual_claims.claim: Management projects continued momentum into 2026, guiding for contracted ARR of DKK 27 to 29 million, full-year revenue of DKK 27 to 29 million, and positive EBITDA of DKK 1 to 2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section (page 32) provides these exact financial guidance figures.

numerical_claims.claim: Consolidated revenue for Konsolidator A/S reached DKK 25.3 million in 2025, representing a twenty-five percent increase from DKK 20.3 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial Highlights and Key Figures table (page 29)

numerical_claims.claim: This growth was driven by a DKK 2.3 million rise in subscription fees to DKK 20.6 million and a 134 percent surge in onboarding and consulting income to DKK 4.7 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: DKK 2.3 million increase in subscription fees to DKK 20.6 million, 134% increase in onboarding/consulting to DKK 4.7 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Subscription fees: DKK 20,621,000 (2025) vs DKK 18,278,000 (2024) [+DKK 2.3M]. Onboarding/consulting: DKK 4,661,000 (2025) vs DKK 1,990,000 (2024) [+134%]

numerical_claims.claim: Profitability metrics showed substantial improvement, with the EBITDA loss narrowing by seventy-seven percent to DKK 2.0 million from DKK 9.3 million the prior year.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EBITDA loss DKK 2.0 million (2025) vs DKK 9.3 million (2024), 77% reduction
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial Highlights and Key Figures table (page 29)

numerical_claims.claim: The second half of 2025 marked a key milestone with a positive EBITDA of DKK 0.5 million, compared to a DKK 3.6 million loss in the same period of 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: H2 2025 EBITDA +DKK 0.5 million vs H2 2024 EBITDA -DKK 3.6 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: H2 2025 EBITDA DKK 538,000 (positive), H2 2024 EBITDA DKK (3,631,000) (loss)

numerical_claims.claim: The net loss for the year decreased to DKK 6.6 million from DKK 14.9 million in 2024, aided by lower external expenses and a favorable change in deferred tax.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Net loss DKK 6.6 million (2025) vs DKK 14.9 million (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial Highlights and Key Figures table (page 29)

numerical_claims.claim: Operating cash flow also strengthened, moving from a negative DKK 9.2 million in 2024 to a negative DKK 1.0 million in 2025, while primary activity cash flow turned positive.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Operating cash flow -DKK 1.0 million (2025) vs -DKK 9.2 million (2024), primary activities positive in 2025
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Cash flow from operating activities DKK (1,047,000) (2025) vs DKK (9,171,000) (2024). Cash flows from primary activities DKK 769,000 (positive) in 2025 vs DKK (7,011,000) in 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Contracted annual recurring revenue grew fifteen percent to DKK 24.4 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Customer acquisition cost payback shortened dramatically from forty-three to twenty-three months, and the customer lifetime value to customer acquisition cost ratio improved to 4.1 from 2.7.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: CAC payback 23 months (2025) vs 43 months (2024), CLV/CAC 4.1 (2025) vs 2.7 (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: CAC payback period 23 months (2025), 43 months (2024). CLV/CAC ratio 4.1 (2025), 2.7 (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Net customer retention held steady at ninety-four percent, though the annual recurring revenue churn rate rose to twelve point six percent from ten point five percent, prompting targeted onboarding process adjustments expected to reduce churn to between six and nine percent in 2026.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Net retention 94% (2025), ARR churn 12.6% (2025) vs 10.5% (2024), target churn 6-9% in 2026
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Net retention 94% (2025), ARR churn rate 12.6% (2025) vs 10.5% (2024). Outlook 2026 targets churn reduction to 6-9%.

numerical_claims.claim: Fifty-two new clients were added, increasing the average contract value per customer to DKK 87,000 from DKK 70,000.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 52 new customers, average CARR/customer DKK 87,000 (2025) vs DKK 70,000 (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 52 new customers added in 2025. Average CARR per customer TDKK 87 (2025) vs TDKK 70 (2024).
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Letter from the Chair and CEO (page 8) and SaaS Metrics 2025 section (page 26)

numerical_claims.claim: The Rule of Forty score rebounded from negative forty percent to seventeen percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Rule of 40 score 17% at year-end 2025 vs -40% in 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Financial stability was reinforced through two private placements raising DKK 4.8 million, resulting in positive parent company equity of DKK 0.7 million despite negative consolidated equity of DKK 3.6 million primarily attributable to the newly established Spanish subsidiary.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: DKK 4.8 million raised via two private placements (Shareholder Information, page 40). Parent company equity DKK 0.7 million positive (Financial Review 2025, page 30). Consolidated equity DKK 3.6 million negative (Balance Sheet, page 46).
